+const fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader = "x-flipt-accept-server-version"
+
+var defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion = semver.Version{Major: 1}
+
+type fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey struct{}
+
+// WithFliptAcceptServerVersion returns a context containing the client's accepted server version.
+func WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx context.Context, version semver.Version) context.Context {
+	return context.WithValue(ctx, fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey{}, version)
+}
+
+// FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext returns the client's accepted server version.
+// It returns the default version when the context has no version.
+func FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx context.Context) semver.Version {
+	if version, ok := ctx.Value(fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey{}).(semver.Version); ok {
+		return version
+	}
+	return defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+}
+
+// FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor stores the accepted server version from request metadata.
+func FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(logger *zap.Logger) grpc.UnaryServerInterceptor {
+	return func(ctx context.Context, req interface{}, _ *grpc.UnaryServerInfo, handler grpc.UnaryHandler) (interface{}, error) {
+		version := defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+		if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
+			if values := md.Get(fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader); len(values) > 0 {
+				parsed, err := semver.Parse(strings.TrimPrefix(values[0], "v"))
+				if err != nil {
+					if logger != nil {
+						logger.Debug("invalid accepted server version", zap.String("version", values[0]), zap.Error(err))
+					}
+				} else {
+					version = parsed
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return handler(WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx, version), req)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+package grpc_middleware
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/blang/semver/v4"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
+)
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(t *testing.T) {
+	version := semver.MustParse("2.3.4")
+	ctx := WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(context.Background(), version)
+	require.Equal(t, version, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+	require.Equal(t, defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(context.Background()))
+}
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		values []string
+		want   semver.Version
+	}{
+		{name: "missing", want: defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion},
+		{name: "prefixed", values: []string{"v2.3.4"}, want: semver.MustParse("2.3.4")},
+		{name: "unprefixed", values: []string{"2.3.4"}, want: semver.MustParse("2.3.4")},
+		{name: "invalid", values: []string{"not-a-version"}, want: defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion},
+		{name: "incomplete", values: []string{"2.3"}, want: defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion},
+		{name: "empty", values: []string{""}, want: defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			if test.values != nil {
+				ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs(fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader, test.values[0]))
+			}
+			called := false
+			resp, err := FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(zaptest.NewLogger(t))(ctx, "request", nil,
+				func(ctx context.Context, req interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+					called = true
+					require.Equal(t, test.want, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+					require.Equal(t, "request", req)
+					return "response", nil
+				})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.True(t, called)
+			require.Equal(t, "response", resp)
+		})
+	}
+}
